author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Cats & Dogs Collection Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the hit asymmetrical multiplayer survival game developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players can now access new Outfits for Vee Boonyasak and Taurie Cain with the 'Cats & Geckos' and "Innocuous Species' skins with the latest collection. The Cats & Dogs Collection for Dead by Daylight is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Dead by Daylight - Official Cats & Dogs Collection Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Closed Playtest #2 Shadow Gameplay Trailer for Horizon Hunters Gathering, an upcoming third-person co-op action-adventure hunting game developed by Guerrilla Games. Players can get a look at Shadow in action, a Carja covert operative who rides a Stalker machine into battle. Horizon Hunters Gathering is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam), with the Closed Playtest #2 running from May 22 through May 25.
title: Horizon Hunters Gathering - Official Closed Playtest #2 Shadow Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch and Mobile Launch Trailer for Farming Simulator 26, the latest addition to the farming simulation game developed by Giants Software. Players will take on new challenges, make use of new equipment, and ensure a streamlined production on the bustling farm. Farming Simulator 26 is available now for Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android.
title: Farming Simulator 26 - Official Nintendo Switch and Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the 'Meet The New Trader' Overview Video for ARC Raiders, the hit third-person action extraction shooter developed by Embark Studios. Players can get the rundown of a new Trader coming to the game from Gerardo Basurto, the Product Director at Embark Studios, with the arrival of Ermal. Ermal will have weekly rotating rewards through trading gear. Learn more about the upcoming Trader in ARC Raiders, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: ARC Raiders - Official 'Meet The New Trader' Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Content Update 7 Launch Trailer for Wreckfest 2, the vehicular combat racing game developed by Bugbear. Players have now been given access to Content Update 7, packed with a brand-new racing venue, the first version of the tuning system, upgraded crash physics, improved AI, new online features, gameplay improvements, and more. Content Update 7 for Wreckfest 2 is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Wreckfest 2 - Official Content Update 7 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the May 2026 Update Launch Trailer for Payday 3, the first-person action crime heist shooter developed by Starbreexe Studios. Players can now access a plethora of content with Update 3.5, with a reworked Turbid Station, new quality-of-life updates, and the highly anticipated return of the LMG Zokas-17. The May 2026 Update for Payday 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Payday 3 - Official May 2026 Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer for Zero Parades: For Dead Spies, a narrative-driven thriller classical RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players can get a developer-led gameplay breakdown on what to expect in the dramatic adventure filled with espionage, dynamic encounters with a suite of different outcomes, and more. Make sense of a world full of lies in Zero Parades: For Dead Spies, launching on May 21 for PC (Steam, GoG, Epic Games Store, and GeForce Now).
title: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Prime Time Limited-Time Event Gameplay Trailer for The Outlast Trials, a first-person survival co-op horror game developed by Red Barrels. Players can soon face the Prime Time Limited-Time Event that's packed with 2 New MK-Challenges, a Limited-Time Event Catalog, bug fixes, balancing, Invasion improvements, and more for players to enjoy. The Prime Time Limited-Time Event launches on June 16 in The Outlast Trials for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Outlast Trials - Official Prime Time Limited-Time Event Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Remorses, a first-person survival horror game developed by Twistedline Games. Players will navigate a sprawling mansion filled with secrets to make sense of. Solve puzzles, stay hidden from threats, and face the terrifying natures of witchcraft. Remorses is launching on June 2 for PC (Steam).
title: Remorses - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Playtest Announcement Trailer for Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon, a sci-fi turn-based RPG developed by Satellite235. Players will command a freight ship to head into deep space to ensure the safe delivery of cargo. Manage the crew, take on enemy warships, and answer distress calls amongst the cosmos. Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon - Official Playtest Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Early Access Gameplay Trailer for Paralives, a life simulation game developed by Alex Masse and Team. Players will embark on the ultimate game of life, from the bad and the good. Find a job, meet new people, and facilitate an original lifetime. Paralives is launching into Early Access on May 25 for PC (Steam).
title: Paralives - Official Early Access Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Every Detail Matters Trailer for PlayStation 5 Pro, the latest and professional iteration of the PlayStation 5 console developed by Sony. Players on PS5 Pro can access advanced ray tracing, super sharp image clarity, and optimized console performance with the PlayStation 5 Pro, offering the most impressive visuals on a console to date. Play on the world's most powerful console with PlayStation 5 Pro, available now.
title: PS5 Pro - Official Every Detail Matters Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Announcement Trailer for World of Tanks: HEAT, the upcoming free-to-play hero-driven tank action multiplayer game developed by Wargaming Group Limited. Players will engage in intense tank-based battles with Agent-specific abilities, tank customization, and more to dominate the battlefield. World of Tanks: HEAT is launching on May 26 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer for The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales, an HD 2D action RPG developed by Claytechworks and Square Enix. Players will explore the lands of Philabieldia to seek the nature of the unknown, seek new weapons, and prepare for battle in a world full of adventure. Engage in action-packed battles and embark on a grand journey in The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales, launching on June 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam). The Prologue demo is also available now on all platforms with save data transfer.
title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales - Official Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Cyberpunk 2077 Collaboration Return Trailer for Arena Breakout: Infinite, the free-to-play extraction first-person shooter developed by Morefun Studios. Players can now deck out their character in Cyberpunk 2077-inspired suits with Trauma Team looks and custom weapons from the CD Projekt Red-developed open-world RPG. Complete activity missions to claim more of the Cyberpunk 2077 Collaboration in Arena Breakout: Infinite, available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Arena Breakout: Infinite x Cyberpunk 2077 - Official Collaboration Return Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out ‘The Water Wars’ DLC Launch Trailer for Dune: Awakening, the hit open-world survival MMO based on the iconic Dune franchise developed by Funcom. Players can now access the new ‘The Water Wars’ DLC, packed with cosmetics, emotes, Ornithopter skins, and more. The ‘The Water Wars’ DLC for Dune: Awakening is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Dune: Awakening - Official ‘The Water Wars’ DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the PS5 and Xbox Launch Trailer for Darksiders: Warmastered Edition, an enhanced version of the hit third-person action hack-and-slash game developed by Kaiko and Vigil Games. Players will embody the first of the four Horsemen of the Apocalypse as War, who seeks redemption after being falsely accused of setting off the end times. Indulge in the action with enhanced visuals, improved performance, and all previously released content, delivering a definitive experience for modern platforms. Darksiders: Warmastered Edition is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Darksiders: Warmastered Edition - Official PS5 and Xbox Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Early Access Launch Trailer for Frontier Legends, a Wild West action RPG developed by Neojac Entertainment. Players will take on the unforgiving lands of the West as a new settler. Scavenge for resources, take out outlaws and bandits alike, and seek the truth of a variety of mysteries. Frontier Legends is launching into Early Access on May 29 for PC (Steam).
title: Frontier Legends - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Hardcore survival action-RPG Outward 2 is announcing its July 7 Early Access launch date in a particularly unique way: by having a potato show you how it will run on almost any half-decent PC gaming rig.

Wishlist Outward 2 on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849490/Outward_2/
title: Outward 2: Official Release Date Trailer (with Potato PC Footage!)

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Random Avatar Matches and Avatar Arcade Mode Trailer for Street Fighter 6, the latest in the iconic fighting game franchise developed by Capcom. Players can soon access new ways to fight with the upcoming Ingrid Update, with the ability to create a custom character with a specific fighting style to take on the opposition in two modes. Earn rewards and level up an Avatar in Random Avatar Matches and Avatar Arcade Mode for Street Fighter 6, launching alongside the Ingrid Update on May 28 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Street Fighter 6 - Official Random Avatar Matches and Avatar Arcade Mode Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Kusan: City of Wolves, an action-packed top-down shooter developed by CIRCLEfromDOT. Players will shoot through an urban jungle to save Haru from an explosive end. Take on 54 missions, solve skill-based puzzles, and achieve S-Rank. Kusan: City of Wolves is launching on July 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Kusan: City of Wolves - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Code Exit, a first-person action survival horror shooter developed by Phase 8 Studio. Players will take on a rogue city governed by an AI gone awry. Take on missions, reveal deep secrets, and escape alone or with up to 4 players in co-op mode. Code Exit is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with a demo available now on PC.

description: Don't miss the 'In Cold Blood' Endgame Update Launch Trailer for Blood Ranks, a dark fantasy isometric MMORPG developed by Whitemoon Games. The 'In Cold Blood' Endgame Update for Blood Ranks is available now for PC and Android.
